question: A mother milks her cow every morning and the milk usually forms curd after three days. What is the first step to investigate why this change happens?
options: A Take action to prevent the milk from curdling
Read scientific articles about the reason for curdling of milk
Formulate hypothesis about the reason for milk curdling
D Ask a question why the milk forms curd
explanation:
The first step in a scientific investigation is to identify and ask a question about the observed phenomenon.
 In this case, the investigation begins by asking why the milk forms curd.

question: A drug efficacy test was conducted under similar set up on two groups of infected mice (A and B). Group A were the control whereas group B were experimental group. A student gave a placebo to the control group and the drug to the experimental group. At the end, the experimental group got better. Which one of the following is true about the result?
options: C The drug has an effect.
explanation: Since the control group received a placebo and did not improve while the experimental group received the drug and got better under the same conditions, the improvement can be attributed to the drug. Therefore, the drug has an effect.

question: Suppose you did an experiment in a biology laboratory and need to report your work to your biology teacher. Which one of the following steps is correct to report the finding?
options: A Title -> Procedure -> Result -> Hypothesis -> Prediction -> Evaluation
B Title -> Hypothesis ->  Procedure -> Prediction -> Conclusion -> Result
C Title -> Hypothesis -> Prediction -> Procedure -> Result -> Conclusion
D Title -> Prediction -> Procedure -> Hypothesis -> Result -> Conclusion
explanation: The correct order to report a scientific experiment is: start with the Title, state the Hypothesis, make a Prediction, describe the Procedure, present the Results, and end with the Conclusion.
